_comment: 视口显示选项（DM_DisplayOption.ui）—— 显示选项对话框里的标签、下拉项与说明文字。
entries: 把构造平面与视平面对齐
Align normal with world X axis
法线对齐世界 X 轴
Align normal with world Y axis
法线对齐世界 Y 轴
Align normal with world Z axis
法线对齐世界 Z 轴
上方向向量对齐构造平面法线
Allow specular highlights in headlight mode
Apply ambient occlusion pass to the headlight for an added sense of depth
给头灯加一遍环境光遮蔽，增强纵深感
Apply display operation to all split views
把显示操作应用到所有分视图
Apply the specified aspect ratio to the viewport
对视口应用指定的宽高比
Apply zooming transformations to background image
对背景图像应用缩放变换
Automatically detect attribute type in UV viewport using the displayed geometry
UV 视口中根据显示的几何体自动识别属性类型
Automatically place rotoscoped image in the viewport
自动把转描图像放进视口
Center c-plane around world X axis
构造平面以世界 X 轴为中心
Center c-plane around world Y axis
构造平面以世界 Y 轴为中心
Center c-plane around world Z axis
构造平面以世界 Z 轴为中心
Crop Render Images to Camera Aspect
按相机宽高比裁剪渲染图像
Cull Gaussian splats whose alpha is below this threshold. Set to 0 to disable extra alpha culling.
剔除 alpha 低于此阈值的高斯泼溅。设为 0 可关闭额外的 alpha 剔除。
Determines which colorspace the video is interpreted as.
决定视频按哪个色彩空间解释。
Display a UV map for geometry with UVs but no material
为有 UV 但无材质的几何体显示 UV 贴图
Display lines at the tile boundaries
在图像上显示像素分辨率网格
Display projected textures and spotlights when using high quality lighting
使用高质量光照时显示投影贴图与聚光灯
显示参考平面/正交网格
Display rotoscoped background image or video in viewport
在视口中显示转描背景图或视频
Display the current camera's foreground image
显示当前相机的前景图像
Display the grid in the ortho viewports
在正交视口中显示网格
Display the reference grid in the uv viewports
在 UV 视口中显示参考网格
Don't display back-facing polygons (available in shaded mode only)
不显示背面多边形（仅着色模式可用）
Don't display the grid outside the image boundaries
不在图像边界外显示网格
Draw object as wireframe where it is occluded.
被遮挡处用线框绘制物体。
Draw the object with a washed-out, ghosted look.
把物体画成褪色、半透明的样子。
Draw without point, primitive or texture colors.
绘制时不使用点、图元或纹理颜色。
Enable Depth of Field when looking through a camera with an fstop greater than zero.
透过光圈值大于零的相机观察时启用景深。
Generate reflection maps on objects with materials that have their GL Reflect parameter greater than the Minimum Reflect option
为材质中「GL 反射」参数大于「最小反射」选项的物体生成反射贴图
把几何体归位到视图中央
把所选几何体归位到视图中央
How the image should be fit to the viewport.
Maps or geometry with alpha will be shown transparently
带 alpha 的贴图或几何体会以透明方式显示
Maximum number of texture samples to filter in anisotropic cases.
各向异性情况下最多过滤的纹理采样数。
Objects with their Origin flags on will draw their axes
打开原点标记的物体会绘制其坐标轴
Objects with their X-ray flags on will be drawn as a dim wireframe when occluded
打开 X 光标记的物体在被遮挡时会以暗淡线框绘制
Open video preview to select range
打开视频预览以选择范围
Optimize packed geometry for OpenGL display by triangulating and splitting vertices.
通过三角化和拆分顶点，为 OpenGL 显示优化打包几何体。
Primitive selections are filled rather than outlined in Smooth Wire shaded mode
平滑线框着色模式下，图元选择以填充而非描边显示
Reload any textures whose source files have changed.
重新加载源文件已改动的纹理。
Render as an environment map rather than a 2D image.
渲染为环境贴图而非 2D 图像。
Replace distant packed geometry with bounding boxes when the scene is too sluggish.
场景过于卡顿时，把远处的打包几何体替换为包围盒。
Reset the current viewport layout to its default layout
把当前视口布局重置为默认布局
Reset to the entire video length
Restore the video source frame rate
Revert all the options for the current renderer back to their defaults
把当前渲染器的所有选项恢复为默认值
恢复为已保存的默认选项
Save these display options as the default
把这些显示选项保存为默认
选择 UV 可视化贴图
Sets the frame rate we use to interpret the video file. This is used to convert the video file to the FPS set in the Global Animation Options.
设置解释视频文件所用的帧率，用于把视频换算到「全局动画选项」里设的 FPS。
Show some extra status information for the current state in the viewport, if applicable
在视口中显示当前状态的一些附加信息（如适用）
Show status badges beside the viewport menus
在视口菜单旁显示状态角标
Show the name of the camera in the corner of the viewport
在视口角落显示相机名称
Show the name of the current insertion point in the corner of the viewport
在视口角落显示当前插入点名称
Show the name of the viewport in the corner of the viewport
在视口角落显示视口名称
The shading mode is not affected by the viewport menu and wireframe toggle when locked.
锁定时，着色模式不受视口菜单和线框开关影响。
Use Light Map Size up to
Use mipmapped textures for improved quality
使用 mipmap 纹理以提升质量
Use the specified attribute in place of Cd
Use this plane as depth if present in the image
若图像中存在此平面则用作深度
When enabled this draws environment maps as a background in the viewport.
启用后在视口中把环境贴图绘制为背景。
When selecting, treat primitives as if they were solid surfaces rather then open wires
选择时把图元当作实心表面而非开放线
